issues.where: upper-right, right, and bottom dark limb (crops C, E, F, H, I; also image-01.png, image-03.png crop R, image-04.png crop V)
issues.what: a detached thin hairline halo runs parallel to the entire dark-side limb with a dark gap between the planet edge and outer arc, plus an isolated orange flare bleeding across the shell in crop C
issues.fix: remove the secondary outer rim layer and blend atmospheric scatter continuously from the planet limb into space without a dark separation gap

issues.where: night-side hemisphere past the terminator (crop P; also image-05.png, image-06.png crop E, image-08.png crop U)
issues.what: gaseous cloud texture abruptly turns into harsh, crunchy, stippled cellular noise that resembles crusty rock or coral rather than clouds
issues.fix: shade the dark hemisphere from the same smooth volumetric cloud field as the lit side and suppress high-frequency bump or upscaler noise in shadow

issues.where: right and lower-right dark limb haze (crops C, E, G, I; also image-05.png, image-07.png crops L, Q)
issues.what: a muddy brownish-grey atmospheric band extends outside the dark limb with concentric banded ridges in crop C and crisp, unattenuated stars sitting directly on top of the haze right up to the hard limb edge
issues.fix: composite stars behind the atmospheric shell with realistic optical extinction near the limb and smooth out the multi-band ridges in the limb haze

issues.where: upper bright limb and outer atmospheric glow (crops K, L; also image-01.png)
issues.what: the sunlit top limb has a terraced double-rim line (bright inner edge, dark trough, sharp orange outer line) and a faint concentric step arc roughly 30 pixels outside the limb
issues.fix: use a single monotonic radial scattering falloff across the sunlit limb so no secondary rim line or outer step ring forms

issues.where: grazing curved cloud bands near upper-right limb and night-side lightning in set 1 (crops C, F; image-02.png crop I; image-03.png crop L)
issues.what: diagonal dark cloud bands near the upper-right limb show aliased pixel stair-stepping at native scale, and the purple lightning strokes in image-02.png crop I have jagged 1-pixel magenta fringes sitting on top of the clouds
issues.fix: supersample grazing-angle limb cloud textures and render lightning as soft subsurface volumetric illumination inside the clouds rather than sharp surface lines

issues.where: lit globe, center tile and upper vortex
issues.what: cloud ridges read as carved, viscous displacement: fibrous relief stays solid instead of scattering like gas
issues.fix: cut displacement amplitude, lay a finer translucent haze over the ridges, and break the uniform filament direction

issues.what: the terminator and nightside lose cloud structure and go soft and muddy
issues.fix: keep a faint high-frequency cloud signal through the shadow and soften the day-night falloff

issues.where: near shadow deck, tiles T and V
issues.what: the darkest foreground clouds flatten; small-scale vapor disappears into a murky mass
issues.fix: lift the shadow floor slightly and retain fine cloud detail in the darks

issues.what: brighter stars are soft round discs about 5 to 8 pixels wide, not points
issues.fix: keep a 1 to 2 pixel core and replace the round halo with a tighter, irregular wing
